name: docsy-starter
description: A Docsy documentation site set up for editing in CloudCannon.
author: The Docsy Starter Authors

scripts.update:docsy: hugo mod get -u github.com/google/docsy/theme && hugo mod tidy && hugo mod npm pack && npm pkg set 'name="@docsy/hugoautogen"' private=true --json --prefix packages/hugoautogen && npm install
